Το πρόσθετο αυτό προσφέρει περιεχόμενο διαθέσιμο στην Ελλάδα και δεν έχει δημοσιευθεί ούτε εγκριθεί από το skai.gr
extension.news: [B]4.0.0[/B] - Complete rework for the current skai.gr, whose skaitv.gr pages and old video section no longer exist - Live TV and live radio, TV shows, trending, cinema trailers and radio podcasts rebuilt on the new layouts - Programme guide (/tv/programma/) as a custom WindowXML dialog with day strip, schedule rows and LIVE badge - Cinema trailers with per-film metadata, like the Alpha add-on's movie listings - Stream resolution delegated to ResolveURL / the PluginsGR SkaiResolver (live m3u8, episode/trailer media files, YouTube embeds via YouTubeGR) - Non-blocking page indicator overlay with configurable screen position and margins - Modernized stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache
